subject.title: feat(cloud-workers): session placement, dispatch, and worker turn routing

question: Should this gateway-only milestone-3 foundation land before the target-bar UI, agent dispatch tool, inbound adoption/checkpoints, and final AWS end-to-end scenario are complete?
rationale: The branch intentionally creates compatibility-sensitive protocol, persisted state, startup, and administrative RPC surfaces while deferring parts of the planned user path, so implementation correctness alone cannot determine the acceptable release boundary.

options.title: Accept foundation after proof
options.body: Land this staged core after real-worker, restart, and upgrade proof confirms the hidden protocol and persistence foundation is safe.

options.title: Require complete milestone
options.body: Hold the PR until the remaining milestone-3 UI, agent-tool, adoption, and final scenario surfaces land together.

options.title: Split the landing units
options.body: Separate protocol and persistence groundwork from dispatch and turn routing to reduce session-state and startup blast radius.

recommendation.title: Accept foundation after proof
recommendation.body: Land this staged core after real-worker, restart, and upgrade proof confirms the hidden protocol and persistence foundation is safe.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the parent design and the complete supplied implementation series, making them the strongest available owner for the intended milestone boundary.
